svg.title: Sauna and shed outbuilding plan v6
svg.desc: Wood-fired sauna building with porch, dressing room and sauna room, and a shed behind it, with network and power items.
svg.text: Sauna and shed outbuilding (north up, 12 ft x 24 ft)
no door to the sauna side
1 PoE switch, fiber in, shed north wall
3 Outdoor PoE AP, inside north wall
J Sauna light control unit, low, dressing room
L1 Low-voltage lights under the sauna bench
L3-L5 Shed (L3, L4), porch (L5, over the door) lights
S1, S2, S4 Dressing, sauna, porch (by door)
S3 Shed lights, by the door
Circuits: C1 B heater 20A; C2 P1, P4, P6
Dashed: low-voltage run from J, low
G Ground bar by camera 2, bonded to A (green)
SP Surge on camera 2 run, on G
J: control unit for the sauna lights, in a 15 x 11 in space low on the dressing room north wall by the sauna door.
L1: strip lights under the seating bench, like under-cabinet lights, heat rated. The low-voltage wire runs low along
the sauna north wall from J to the bench, away from the wood stove.
G is bonded to subpanel A's grounding bar (green line along the east wall) and to the shed ground rods.
Doors: porch door from the dressing room, 2'8", hinged west, opens out onto the porch. Sauna door at the north end
of the wall between the dressing room and the sauna, 2'0", hinged north, opens out into the dressing room (owner decision).
Shed outlets P2, P3 and P5 removed (Nov 10, 2026). P6 moved north to where P2 was, by switch 1. Now: P1, P4, P6.
